_about: Single source of truth for what counts as a match. Read by cl_watch.py, email_watch.py and Claude's hourly check. Edit here, not in the scripts.
must_have: real parking (garage, off-street, assigned; extra fee OK)
in-unit washer/dryer — EXCEPT a rent-controlled unit with laundry in the building is acceptable (tag it 'near-miss: shared laundry')
dealbreakers: No Presidio Residences / Baker Beach / inner-Presidio housing (Nov 16): too hard to commute to 525 Market. Presidio HEIGHTS (the neighborhood south of the park) is still fine.
notes: Already reviewed & passed (Nov 15): 3150 Franklin #03 (Veritas, $5,495 + $400 parking, shared laundry). Don't push it again under any address/title.
_reject_phrases: Exact phrases (lowercase). A post containing any is rejected by the scripts and by Claude.
_dealbreakers: Plain-English rules for Claude to judge (e.g. 'no units on Geary or Lombard'). Scripts can't check these; Claude's hourly check and report do.
_shared_laundry_ok_if_rent_controlled: Luke (Nov 15): would consider shared/in-building laundry if the unit is rent-controlled (SF Rent Ordinance / built before mid-1979). Push these, tagged near-miss.
_area_boxes: Map-pin boxes [lat_min, lat_max, lon_min, lon_max]: Marina/Cow Hollow/Pac Hts (west of Van Ness); Russian Hill/North Beach/Telegraph Hill (north of Broadway, so Nob Hill is out); Inner Richmond/Laurel Hts/Presidio Hts.
_exclude_neighborhoods: Luke (Nov 15): Craigslist was pushing Lower Nob Hill. Reject posts whose neighborhood label or title names one of these, unless it also names a target neighborhood.
_one_br_needs_sqft: Luke (Nov 15): too many small places. 1BRs must state 750+ sq ft; junior 1BRs and studios are out. 2BRs with no size listed still pass.
